name: s81sl_lepab_r1a-s81sl_lepab_r1a-8eb663ae9
purpose: Regional structural successor after t5c/t5d one-root/1.6mm setup -0.9ns. Two native32 pair-A cores, C dispatch/registered onehot merge; all C<->A/B buses real D4K2 rings, three independent related CTS roots. Every path receives ordinary same-frequency STA (no data multicycle or async cuts). Two-edge matched outer lane payload/valid and reverse return relays; endpoint DR/CRED12 and peer CORE_CRED12. New ML E-face matched bus bands, old N-face fit invalid. Parent R0 land and existing ML E2 landing chunk placement pending, with +1 eachway owed if those stages cannot cover<=405um segments. Cycle model: +4 centre-to-pair, +5 pair-to-centre, +2 lane data/valid and +2 reverse returns, RTT+4. New strict view/ports required, no alias of old AB or CRED8.
